caption: sky note: "don't date during mars retrograde, it's doomed." not true. mars stations retrograde in virgo on sunday, jan 10.

slides.headline: “anything that starts in *mars retrograde* is doomed”
“don't date until mars goes direct. it won't last”
slides.body: nobody has shown that relationships started in mars retrograde end sooner. it's a reading, not a statistic.

slides.headline: earth is the *faster* car on the inside lane
slides.body: as earth passes mars, mars appears to slow, stop and drift back against the stars. from jan 10 it does that in virgo.

slides.headline: retrograde reads as *slow*, not doomed
slides.body: astrologers read mars retrograde as lower, tired drive: better for slow starts and second looks than for rushing in.

slides.headline: date if you want to. just *go slower*.
slides.body: if it ends, it wasn't mars. put your dealbreakers up front.
